scenarios.description: A decision due within the hour (being read aloud), a choice, a yes/no question, a form answered in Fractal and an update; an objective missed and a budget nearly spent.
scenarios.title: Busy inbox

scenarios.description: Answers in flight and settled: one still sending, one committed by Fractal, one refused by Fractal with its reason.
scenarios.title: Answering

scenarios.description: Nothing needs the person; away until tomorrow 9:00 with urgent interruptions only and routine deadlines held.
scenarios.title: Quiet

scenarios.description: The device may read but not answer: native asks link to Fractal and the panel says why.
scenarios.title: Read-only device

scenarios.description: The last read failed: every section is marked stale and keeps the data it last had.
scenarios.title: Fractal unreachable

scenarios.description: The tray started without its Fractal configuration and says what to set.
scenarios.title: Not configured

scenarios.description: A critical ask is being read aloud with Stop and Mute this agent; a second waits in the queue with Skip.
scenarios.title: Speaking

scenarios.description: The microphone and camera are in use: a critical ask shows as a banner but is not spoken; the person may allow speech for this call.
scenarios.title: In a call

scenarios.description: Speech muted for an hour and one agent muted for today: critical asks still show as banners.
scenarios.title: Speech muted

scenarios.description: The decision being read aloud: Stop, its answers as buttons, Request changes as a text reply, Mute this agent, Open in Fractal.
scenarios.title: Notification while speaking

scenarios.description: A feedback ask held for a call: no Stop, a text reply for the feedback.
scenarios.title: Notification in a call

scenarios.description: After Fractal committed the answer: the notification says so and offers only Open in Fractal.
scenarios.title: Answered from the notification
